## The Problem

```{=html}
<div class="slide-body slide-layout">
<p class="slide-intro">VCs review thousands of startups, but partner time and attention are limited.</p>
<div class="hero-stat">20,000+</div>
<div class="hero-stat-label">startups in the pipeline</div>
<div class="callout problem-callout">Imagine Shark Tank, but with <span class="metric-sm">20,000</span> startups in a spreadsheet.</div>
<div class="emphasis-note">The issue is not a lack of data — it is <strong>too much scattered data</strong> and <strong>not enough partner attention</strong>.</div>
<div class="problem-lower-row">
  <ul>
    <li>Signals live across CRM, spreadsheets, and research tools</li>
    <li>Partner time is the scarcest resource</li>
    <li>Most deals never get a real look</li>
    <li>Great companies get lost in the noise</li>
  </ul>
  <div class="slide-visual-box problem-visual problem-photo">
    <img src="problem-crowd.png" alt="Dense crowd — thousands of startups competing for limited investor attention" loading="lazy"/>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Before AI

```{=html}
<div class="slide-body slide-layout before-ai-slide">
  <div class="before-ai-main">
    <p class="slide-intro">The traditional process is manual, inconsistent, and hard to scale.</p>
    <div class="flow">
      <div class="flow-step">CRM Data</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step">Spreadsheets</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>

      <div class="flow-step">PitchBook / Harmonic</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step muted-step">Gut Feeling</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step muted-step">Partner Review</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pain-tags">
      <div class="pain-tag bad">Slow</div>
      <div class="pain-tag bad">Inconsistent</div>
      <div class="pain-tag bad">Hard to Scale</div>
      <div class="pain-tag bad">Data Silos</div>
    </div>
    <div class="callout callout-accent">Manual screening is uneven and time-bound — high-potential startups slip through when analysts cannot research every company the same way.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="before-ai-photo">
    <img src="before-ai-desk.png" alt="Cluttered analyst desk — manual research across scattered tools" loading="lazy"/>
  </div>
</div>
```

## AI-Assisted Deal Flow

```{=html}
<div class="slide-body slide-layout">
<p class="slide-intro">AI gives deal flow a brain — unified data, faster insight, and prioritized review.</p>
<div class="content-split content-split-ai">
  <div class="content-main">
    <div class="flow">
      <div class="flow-step">CRM + Harmonic + PitchBook</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step highlight">AI Summaries</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step highlight">Investment Signals</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step highlight-green">Relevance Scoring</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
      <div class="flow-step highlight-purple">Prioritized Deal Flow</div>
    </div>
    <ul>
      <li>External data unified into one view</li>
      <li>AI distills company narratives in seconds</li>
      <li>Signals surface thesis-fit opportunities automatically</li>
      <li>Partners review the <strong class="metric-sm">best</strong> deals first — not just the loudest</li>
    </ul>
    <div class="callout callout-scoring">Relevance scoring is <strong>not a black-box model</strong> — it is a structured layer that ranks companies using partner-selected investment criteria.</div>
    <div class="callout callout-purple">AI doesn't replace judgment — it front-loads intelligence so investors spend time where it matters.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="slide-visual-box slide-ai-photo">
    <img src="ai-funnel.png" alt="Layered funnels — deal flow filtered and prioritized" loading="lazy"/>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Marketing Analytics

```{=html}
<div class="slide-body slide-layout slide-analytics">
<p class="slide-intro">Segment the universe, then rank companies with a transparent weighted scoring model partners control.</p>
<div class="analytics-viz">
  <div class="viz-panel segment-panel">
    <div class="viz-title">Segmentation · Unsupervised ML</div>
    <svg class="viz-svg" viewBox="0 0 420 240" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Startup segmentation map">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="420" height="240" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)" rx="8"/>
      <text x="52" y="28" fill="#8a8278" font-size="11" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">THESIS FIT ↑</text>
      <text x="330" y="228" fill="#8a8278" font-size="11" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">GROWTH →</text>
      <line x1="55" y1="205" x2="395" y2="205" stroke="#c9c2b6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="55" y1="205" x2="55" y2="40" stroke="#c9c2b6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="145" cy="75" r="34" fill="rgba(122,59,53,0.12)" stroke="#7a3b35" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="145" y="72" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Investor-</text>
      <text x="145" y="84" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Backed</text>
      <circle cx="310" cy="62" r="36" fill="rgba(47,129,247,0.15)" stroke="#2f81f7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="310" y="59" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">High-Growth</text>
      <text x="310" y="71" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">AI</text>
      <circle cx="335" cy="130" r="30" fill="rgba(130,80,223,0.14)" stroke="#8250df" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="335" y="127" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Recently</text>
      <text x="335" y="139" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="10" font-weight="600" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Funded</text>
      <circle cx="210" cy="118" r="38" fill="rgba(45,164,78,0.16)" stroke="#2da44e" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <text x="210" y="115" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="11" font-weight="700" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Hidden</text>
      <text x="210" y="127" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2e2825" font-size="11" font-weight="700" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Gems</text>
      <circle cx="95" cy="175" r="24" fill="rgba(46,40,37,0.06)" stroke="#8a8278" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
      <text x="95" y="178" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8a8278" font-size="9" font-family="DM Sans, sans-serif">Low-Fit</text>
    </svg>
    <p class="viz-caption">Segment startups into natural groups based on growth, thesis fit, funding, and investor signals.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="viz-panel scoring-panel">
    <div class="viz-title">Key Drivers · Weighted Scoring Model</div>
    <div class="formula-card">
      <span class="formula-label">Relevance Score</span>
      <span class="formula-eq">= Σ (Driver Score × Partner Weight)</span>
    </div>
    <ul class="scoring-meta">
      <li><strong>Method:</strong> Partner-adjustable weighted relevance scoring</li>
      <li><strong>Goal:</strong> Rank companies by relevance</li>
      <li><strong>Output:</strong> Top 10 / 20 / 50 companies</li>
    </ul>
    <div class="driver-weights">
      <div class="driver-weights-title">Illustrative Partner Weights</div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">Thesis fit</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:88%"></span></span><span class="d-val">22%</span></div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">Stage fit</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:72%"></span></span><span class="d-val">18%</span></div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">Funding</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:64%"></span></span><span class="d-val">16%</span></div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">Investors</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:56%"></span></span><span class="d-val">14%</span></div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">Headcount</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:48%"></span></span><span class="d-val">12%</span></div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">Geography</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:40%"></span></span><span class="d-val">10%</span></div>
      <div class="driver-row"><span class="d-label">CRM history</span><span class="d-track"><span class="d-fill" style="width:32%"></span></span><span class="d-val">8%</span></div>
    </div>
    <p class="viz-caption scoring-caption">Each startup gets driver scores; partners adjust weights by thesis. Example: $10M+ funding → raise funding weight; Series A focus → raise stage-fit weight.</p>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Impact

```{=html}
<div class="slide-body slide-static slide-impact">
<p class="slide-intro">The goal is not to replace investors — it's to help them focus.</p>
<div class="impact-grid">
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Less Manual Screening</strong>Automate the first pass across thousands of companies</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Faster Review</strong>AI summaries cut research time from hours to minutes</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Consistent Scoring</strong>Every deal evaluated with the same framework</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Better Data Use</strong>Harmonic, PitchBook, and CRM signals unified</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Easier Prioritization</strong>Ranked deal flow replaces gut-only triage</div>
  <div class="impact-item"><strong>Hidden Gems Found</strong>Strong startups surface before competitors notice</div>
</div>
<div class="callout callout-arms">
  <div class="arms-title">The AI Arms Race</div>
  <p>If VCs use AI to review startups, founders may use AI to optimize pitches. To avoid AI evaluating AI-generated language, rely on harder-to-fake signals: funding history, headcount growth, investor quality, CRM activity, traction, and human judgment.</p>
  <p class="arms-quote">AI can polish a pitch, but it cannot easily fake traction.</p>
</div>
<div class="closing">This project applies marketing analytics thinking to venture capital: using AI, segmentation, and relevance scoring to turn messy deal flow into smarter investment decisions.</div>
</div>
```
